items.en: Business agents
items.zh: 业务 Agent

items.en: Agents take the initiative.
items.zh: Agent 主动工作。

items.en: Traditional business software depends on people to record data, route work, and handle every step by hand. In NocoBase Solution, each app comes with built-in business agents that follow your rules and proactively take on most of the work, such as checking refunds and handling tickets.
items.zh: 传统业务软件靠人来记录、流转和操作。在 Solution 里，每个应用中内置很多业务 Agent，它们会按照规则主动承担大部分执行工作，比如核查退款、处理工单。

items.en: Every agent spells out its job, when it works, and how.
items.zh: 每个 Agent 管什么、什么时候工作、按什么方法做，都写得清清楚楚。

items.en: Starts when something happens:
items.zh: 事情发生就开始工作：

items.en: a new lead, a customer email, or a finished task sets the right agent to work, and agents can also run on a schedule.
items.zh: 新线索进来、客户来信、任务完成时，对应的 Agent 自动开始工作，也可以按时间定期运行。

items.en: Follows your rules:
items.zh: 按你的规则做事：

items.en: business guidance sets out your context and standards, skills set out the method, and the next run follows any change you make.
items.zh: 业务指导写明企业的背景和口径，技能写明做事的方法，改了以后，Agent 下次运行就照新的做。

items.en: Keeps a record:
items.zh: 做了什么都有记录：

items.en: how often each agent ran, and what was accepted or ignored, is all on record.
items.zh: 每个 Agent 运行了多少次、哪些被采纳、哪些被忽略，都记录在案。

items.en: Who does what
items.zh: 人与 Agent 的分工

items.en: People own the key decisions.
items.zh: 人负责关键决策。

items.en: Agents show the evidence behind their work, and key decisions are always made by a person. Each agent inherits the permissions of the person it works for, so data stays secure.
items.zh: Agent 的工作成果会附上依据，关键决策必须由人来做。Agent 继承负责人的权限，保证数据安全。

items.en: App
items.zh: 应用

items.en: Business agents handle
items.zh: 业务 Agent 负责

items.en: People decide
items.zh: 人来拍板

items.en: Keep customer records and conversations up to date, research leads and companies, suggest next steps, and pre-check quotes
items.zh: 整理客户与沟通记录、调研线索与公司、建议商机下一步、预审报价

items.en: Discounts, quotes, and contract terms
items.zh: 折扣、报价与合同承诺

items.en: Reconcile asset records with MDM, prepare onboarding and offboarding kits, and pre-review purchase and disposal requests
items.zh: 核对资产台账与 MDM、准备入职和离职的配发方案、初审采购与报废申请

items.en: Purchases, disposals, and major asset changes
items.zh: 采购、报废与重要资产变更

items.en: Analyze the data every day, find growth opportunities with evidence, and open pull requests with the changes
items.zh: 每天分析数据、找出增长机会并附上依据，在仓库里改好代码提 PR

items.en: Which opportunities to take, brand review, and release
items.zh: 采纳哪些机会、品牌把关与上线

items.en: Soon
items.zh: 即将推出

items.en: Triage and route tickets, search the knowledge base, and draft replies
items.zh: 工单分类分派、检索知识库、起草回复

items.en: Refunds, escalations, and exceptions
items.zh: 退款、投诉升级与特例处理

items.en: Run research and drafting tasks, track progress, and flag risks
items.zh: 执行调研与文档任务、跟进进度、汇总风险

items.en: Goals, priorities, and sign-off
items.zh: 目标、优先级与成果验收

items.en: Prepare onboarding, keep employee records, and answer policy questions
items.zh: 准备入职事项、整理员工档案、解答制度提问

items.en: Hiring, pay, and HR exceptions
items.zh: 录用、定薪与人事特批

items.en: Evidence attached
items.zh: 附上依据

items.en: Everything an agent hands over says where it came from: which email, which record, which document.
items.zh: Agent 交上来的每个结果都写明依据：来自哪封邮件、哪条记录、哪份资料。

items.en: A person decides
items.zh: 关键决策由人做

items.en: For decisions like discounts, purchases, and refunds, the agent prepares the options and reasons, and the person responsible makes the call.
items.zh: 折扣、采购、退款这类决定，Agent 只准备好方案和理由，由负责人拍板。

items.en: The owner’s permissions
items.zh: 继承负责人的权限

items.en: An agent can see and change only what the person it works for can, never more.
items.zh: Agent 能看到、能改动的数据，和它所服务的负责人一致，不会越权。

items.en: Customize
items.zh: 定制

items.en: Easy to customize.
items.zh: 方便定制开发。

items.en: Every app is built on NocoBase Core, with its consistent architecture and reliable foundation, so you can have a coding agent customize it.
items.zh: 基于 NocoBase Core 开发，具备统一的架构和可靠的底座，可以让 Coding Agent 对它们进行定制开发。

items.en: Deploy and run
items.zh: 部署即用

items.en: Each app deploys on its own. Add your business guidance, connect a model, and the business agents get to work.
items.zh: 每款应用都可以独立部署。写好业务指导、接上模型，业务 Agent 就开始工作。

items.en: Change skills, rules, and code
items.zh: 改技能、规则和代码

items.en: When the method changes, edit a skill. When workflows or fields change, have a coding agent change the source.
items.zh: 做法变了，改技能；流程和字段变了，让 Coding Agent 改源码。

items.en: Take official updates when you choose
items.zh: 按需合入官方更新

items.en: The customized source is yours. Merge the official updates you want into your own repository after checking them.
items.zh: 定制后的源码归企业所有，需要的官方更新，验证后合入自己的仓库。
